result.title: StaX-Net: Stackelberg Interleaved Asymmetric Network for Cross-Modality Medical Image Translation
result.summary: Cross-modality medical image translation is challenged by anatomically inconsistent synthesis that can compromise clinical diagnosis. We propose StaX-Net, a Stackelberg interleaved asymmetric network that incorporates a partially coupled encoder-discriminator structure, and a 2D feature aggregation and spatial transformation (FAST) layer that distills target-supervised priors under the learning using privileged information paradigm. The shared blocks between the generator and discriminator enhance architectural feature alignment. To stabilize the leader-follower training, a Stackelberg-inspired asymmetric optimization scheme employs explicit shared-parameter freezing and asymmetric learning rates. The FAST layer distills target-domain priors during training and applies a source-only transform at inference. This constrains the synthesis process through target-informed feature representations relative to standard generative architectures. The code is available on GitHub for public use.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 StaX-Net，用部分耦合的编码器-判别器结构与 FAST 层，在 learning using privileged information 范式下蒸馏目标域先验，并借助共享参数冻结与非对称学习率的 Stackelberg 式优化稳定训练，实现跨模态医学图像翻译。
AI.relevance_reason: 任务本身是医学图像生成，无推理期 latent 状态；但其「训练期用目标域特权信息监督、推理期仅保留源域变换」的 LUPI 蒸馏与非对称优化，或可为 LVR 中训练期潜在状态监督与推理期轻量化的分工提供核查线索。
